gates.limitations: 514 AI-reviewed records change label provenance, not image membership; no image bytes are tracked.

gates.evidence: The workflow's Python tests have no failures in the full local run; Node tests passed 7/7, frontend build passed, and offline retrieval evaluation exited 0.
gates.limitations: GitHub-hosted workflow status is separate and not established by these local checks.

gates.evidence: pytest tests exits 0: 484 passed, 11 skipped, 38 deselected. With ITASMM_ACCEPTANCE_DATASET_ROOT set, tests/acceptance_v2 passes 11/11. Node 7/7, frontend build, git lfs fsck and dataset_v2 manifest verification pass.

gates.evidence: 394 TEST frames, 11 clip groups, 1028 canonical boxes; baseline precision/recall 0.8838/0.7772, candidate 0.8940/0.7792.
gates.limitations: Canonical source annotations are not independent human field GT; paired clip-bootstrap intervals for both differences include zero.

gates.evidence: Baseline 353/375 and candidate 360/381 agreement with eligible matched AI labels.
gates.limitations: The same recognizer generated those labels, and candidate matching informed eligibility; these are circular agreement figures, not independent accuracy.

gates.evidence: Three fixed 60-second V0 segments were rendered and fully decoded; inference measured 3.12-4.09 calls/s and rendering 10.36-13.18 frames/s.
gates.limitations: No event GT; repeated warnings include status notices; stale count is a crop-age proxy, not verification of overlay age. TTS was disabled during measurement.

gaps: AI-reviewed codes and lane proposals are not human GT

gates.evidence: 35 of 394 selected TEST frames have lane proposals.
gaps: No human lane GT exists; the proposal rate is not precision, recall, or F1

gates.limitations: Speech intelligibility was not assessed by listening; some original sign labels overlap in one visually inspected frame.
